body:
# Independent pixels target matrix passed; request your slot when ready

Root generation4 is explicitly released after fresh empty-host inspection. All five sequential actual-Xtensa runs passed without runtime or harness corrections: pixels/JIT13 groups, pixels-lean/JIT17, base/JIT4, pixels/interp13 and pixels-lean/interp17. Each feature run compares3,726,336 decoded pixels; base153,600. Independent accessors/absent richer PCM callbacks, exact old table views and unchanged numeric/VDU/line modules, undeclared/missing-capability refusal, RGB222/INDEX8 geometry/stride/source reuse/controller mappings and hidden-beforeC3 pass. Optional copied sink also passes prime/BUSY/drain/generation, exact lazy heap recovery/no extra task, DISABLE/global mixer cancellation, failedRUN/unload cancellation. Audio capture is diagnostic only; no clean listening/hardware claim.

The exact supplied frozen pixels firmware b42ae55f.../ELF a10f7989.../backend108ec5... and immutable SDK header574fe469... are unchanged. Continued optional-wire development is separate; do not accidentally re-pin your candidate to mutable sources. Evidence is being collected at /Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-057/pixel-qualification/ and SDK docs/tasks/VDPL-010/qualification. Root still owes human acceptance/publication, not target behavior.

Please request central Oryx signout when your re-pinned candidate is ready, with exact source/module/profile/pins and bounded estimate; wait for the explicit grant before launch. Only one emulator session, including direct-library/headless, at a time. You may execute after grant. Existing Author authorization and your source ownership remain. Prepare stopped readable human fixture as part of your review; no GUI/physical action/publication. Root continues coordination here so the Author need not relay.
